summary: Iter-6 testing complete. 91/91 backend tests pass (75 prior + 16 new). All critical iter-6 UI flows verified: admin Edit/Duplicate buttons on gig detail, EditGigDialog pre-populated with location+address, Duplicate creates new gig with '(copy)' title, worker verification banner on /app feed (both 'Upload your ID' and 'Awaiting HCOB' wording), worker verification-required-card on gig detail (with go-to-profile-btn when no ID, without it when ID is uploaded but unverified), accept-gig-btn correctly hidden until verified, full-address-card correctly hidden until accept (sensitive address absent from DOM), and the 'Full address is revealed after you accept' hint shown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (>1.6k lines). Consider splitting iter-6 endpoints (PUT /gigs/{id}, POST /gigs/{id}/duplicate, _strip_sensitive_for_worker) into a dedicated gigs router module to keep server.py under the 700-line guideline.

Regression risk: re-uploading an ID resets id_verified=False (server.py line ~477). This is correct behavior but worth documenting on the worker profile UI so a verified worker doesn't accidentally lose access by re-uploading.
EditGigDialog and CreateGigDialog share ~80% of the same field-render code. Extract a shared <GigFormFields/> component to remove duplication.
